errors.evidence: The peak for the orange line (Инвест банк) is in the year 2013, not 2014. The value in 2013 is approximately 140%, while in 2014 it has already decreased to about 120%.
Describing the line for "Общинска банка" as simply "сива линия" (grey line) is ambiguous because there are three distinct grey lines in the chart, each representing a different bank.
The line for "Интернешънъл Асет Банк" is a medium grey. The line for "Общинска банка" is visibly darker. Describing the medium grey line as "по-тъмно сива" (darker grey) is incorrect in this context.

errors.evidence: The light grey line for "Д Банк" starts at approximately 88-90% in 2007, not 80%. The value of 80% corresponds to the starting point of a different bank ("Интернешънъл Асет Банк").
